about: Maps that tools/build.py draws all-classic in HD (tools/sprite_scene.py build --classic: Median's own floors, walls, roofs and props, black ground outside the map's floor, the map's own light tuned against classic). A map not listed keeps the default build's scene. Take a map off by deleting its line; an empty list gives the default build byte for byte. docs/maps-hd.md "Classic maps"
